title: past simple: was / were
rule_uz: O'tgan zamonda "to be" fe'li was yoki were bo'ladi. I, he, she, it bilan was ishlatamiz. You, we, they bilan were ishlatamiz. Inkorda wasn't va weren't deymiz. Savolda was yoki were gapning boshiga chiqadi: Were you at home?

examples.en: I was at school yesterday.
My parents were in Samarkand last week.
Were you happy at the party?

mistakes.note_uz: I bilan were emas, was ishlatiladi.
They bilan were ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ at home yesterday.
They ___ in the park last Sunday.
She ___ very happy at the party last night.
My parents ___ in Samarkand two days ago.
___ you tired after the trip yesterday?
Where ___ your brother and his friends last night?

title: past simple: regular verbs (-ed)
rule_uz: O'tgan zamonda tugagan ishlar haqida gapiramiz. Oddiy fe'llarga -ed qo'shamiz: play - played. Fe'l -e bilan tugasa, faqat -d qo'shamiz: like - liked. Undosh + y bilan tugasa, -ied bo'ladi: study - studied. Qisqa fe'llarda oxirgi harf ikki marta yoziladi: stop - stopped. Barcha shaxslarda fe'l shakli bir xil.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + played

examples.en: We played football yesterday.
She studied English last night.
examples.uz: U kecha kechqurun ingliz tilini o'qidi.

examples.en: The bus stopped near the school.

mistakes.note_uz: Undosh + y bilan tugasa, y o'rniga -ied yoziladi.
Qisqa fe'lda oxirgi p harfi ikkita bo'ladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: We ___ football yesterday.
She ___ her room last Saturday.
I ___ a cake with my mum two days ago.
Tom ___ for the test last night.
The bus ___ at the school gate a minute ago.
My grandfather ___ in a small village when he was a boy.

title: past simple: common irregular verbs
rule_uz: Ba'zi fe'llar o'tgan zamonda -ed olmaydi, ularning shakli butunlay o'zgaradi. Ularni yodlash kerak: go - went, have - had, see - saw, eat - ate, buy - bought. Bu shakllar I, he, she, we, they bilan bir xil ishlatiladi. Kecha, o'tgan hafta kabi so'zlar o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I went to the market with my dad.
We ate pizza for dinner.
She bought a new bag last week.
examples.uz: U o'tgan hafta yangi sumka sotib oldi.

mistakes.wrong: I goed to school by bus.
mistakes.right: I went to school by bus.
mistakes.note_uz: Go fe'lining o'tgan zamoni went, goed emas.
Buy - bought, -ed qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ to the market with my dad yesterday.
We ___ pizza for dinner last night.
She ___ a new bag last week.
Aziza ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.
They ___ a big fish in the river two days ago.
He ___ his book home last Monday.

title: past simple: negatives and questions (didn't / did)
rule_uz: O'tgan zamonda inkor gap uchun didn't ishlatamiz: I didn't play. Savol uchun Did gapning boshiga chiqadi: Did you play? Didn't va Did dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda qoladi, -ed yoki o'tgan shakl qo'shilmaydi. Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + didn't + go
Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

examples.en: I didn't watch TV last night.
Did you play chess yesterday?
Where did she go last summer?

mistakes.note_uz: Did dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda bo'ladi.
Didn't dan keyin -ed qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ watch TV last night.
___ you play football yesterday?
She didn't ___ the homework.
Did he ___ to school by bus?
We ___ see the film because the cinema was closed.
Where ___ your sister go last summer?

title: past time expressions (yesterday, last week, two days ago)
rule_uz: Ba'zi so'zlar ishning o'tgan zamonda bo'lganini ko'rsatadi. Yesterday (kecha), last week (o'tgan hafta), last year (o'tgan yil) deymiz. Ago "oldin" degani, u vaqtdan keyin keladi: two days ago, ten years ago. Bunday so'zlar bilan odatda past simple ishlatamiz. Last bilan yesterday ni aralashtirmang: last night, yesterday morning.
forms: last night / last week / last year
two days ago / a year ago

examples.en: I visited my grandma yesterday.
We went to the zoo last week.
examples.uz: Biz o'tgan hafta hayvonot bog'iga bordik.

examples.en: She was born ten years ago.

mistakes.wrong: I saw him before two days.
mistakes.right: I saw him two days ago.
mistakes.note_uz: "Oldin" ma'nosida ago so'zi vaqtdan keyin keladi.

mistakes.wrong: We played football the last week.
mistakes.note_uz: Last dan oldin the qo'yilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I visited my grandma ___.
We went to the zoo ___ week.
She was born ten years ___.
Dilshod played chess ___ evening.
My uncle came to our house ___ Sunday.
I started learning English three years ___, and now I speak it well.

title: comparative adjectives
rule_uz: Ikkita narsani solishtirganda comparative ishlatamiz va keyin than deymiz. Qisqa sifatlarga -er qo'shamiz: tall - taller. -y bilan tugasa, -ier bo'ladi: easy - easier. Uzun sifatlar oldiga more qo'yiladi: more interesting. Ba'zilari alohida: good - better, bad - worse.

examples.en: An elephant is bigger than a horse.
This book is more interesting than that one.
My English is better than before.

mistakes.wrong: She is more tall than me.
mistakes.note_uz: Qisqa sifatlarga more emas, -er qo'shiladi.
Good ning qiyosiy darajasi better.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: An elephant is ___ than a horse.
My brother is ___ than me.
This book is ___ than that one.
Maths is ___ than history for me.
Your English is ___ than mine.
Her new phone is much ___ than her old one.

title: superlative adjectives
rule_uz: Ikkitadan ko'p narsa ichida eng ... narsani aytganda superlative ishlatamiz va oldidan the qo'yamiz. Qisqa sifatlarga -est qo'shamiz: tall - the tallest. -y bilan tugasa: funny - the funniest. Uzun sifatlar oldiga the most qo'yiladi: the most interesting. Good - the best, bad - the worst.
forms: good - the best, bad - the worst

examples.en: Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Ali is the tallest boy in our class.
This is the best day of my life.
examples.uz: Bu mening hayotimdagi eng yaxshi kun.

mistakes.wrong: She is the most tall girl.
mistakes.note_uz: Qisqa sifatlarga most emas, -est qo'shiladi.

mistakes.wrong: He is tallest in the class.
mistakes.right: He is the tallest in the class.
mistakes.note_uz: Superlative oldidan the kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
Ali is the ___ boy in our class.
This is the ___ film I know.
She is the ___ student in the school.
That was the ___ day of my life.
It was the ___ expensive hotel in the city.

title: as ... as / not as ... as
rule_uz: Ikki narsa bir xil bo'lsa, as + sifat + as ishlatamiz: as tall as. Bir xil bo'lmasa, not as ... as deymiz: not as tall as, ya'ni "unchalik ... emas". Sifat ikkita as orasida o'zgarmaydi: as big as, as fast as. Bu yerda than ishlatilmaydi.
forms: as fast as / as old as

examples.en: I am as tall as my sister.
examples.uz: Men opam bilan bir xil bo'yliman.

examples.en: This bag is not as heavy as that one.
Bobur runs as fast as a rabbit.

mistakes.wrong: He is as tall than me.
mistakes.right: He is as tall as me.
mistakes.note_uz: As ... as ichida than emas, ikkinchi as ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: She is not as faster as me.
mistakes.right: She is not as fast as me.
mistakes.note_uz: As ... as orasida sifat oddiy shaklda turadi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: My cat is as small ___ your cat.
I am as tall ___ my sister.
This bag is not as heavy ___ that one.
Bobur runs as ___ as a rabbit.
Chess is not ___ difficult as maths for me.
Amir is 12 and Sara is 12. Amir is ___ old as Sara.

title: going to (plans and intentions)
rule_uz: Kelajak rejalari va niyatlarimiz haqida gapirganda be going to ishlatamiz. Shakli: am / is / are + going to + fe'l. Masalan: I am going to visit my grandma. Hozir ko'rinib turgan belgi bo'yicha ham ishlatiladi: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain. Inkorda not qo'shamiz: She isn't going to come.
forms: He / she / it is going to + verb
We / you / they are going to + verb

examples.en: I am going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
They are going to play football after school.
Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.

mistakes.wrong: I going to buy a bike.
mistakes.right: I am going to buy a bike.
mistakes.note_uz: Going to dan oldin am / is / are kerak.

mistakes.wrong: She is going to buys a gift.
mistakes.right: She is going to buy a gift.
mistakes.note_uz: Going to dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda bo'ladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ going to visit my grandma tomorrow.
She is going to ___ a new bike.
They ___ going to play football after school.
Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
___ you going to watch the match tonight?
We ___ going to have a picnic because the weather is bad.

title: will (predictions, quick decisions, promises)
rule_uz: Will bilan taxmin, shu zumda qilingan qaror va va'dalar haqida gapiramiz. Shakli: will + fe'l, hamma shaxslarda bir xil: I will help, she will help. Qisqa shakli 'll: I'll help. Inkori will not yoki won't. Savol: Will you help me? Will dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + will + verb

examples.en: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
It's cold. I'll close the window.
I promise I won't be late again.

mistakes.note_uz: Will ga -s qo'shilmaydi.
Will dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.
It's cold in here. I ___ close the window.
I promise I ___ be late again.
Don't worry. Mum ___ help you with your homework.
I think Uzbekistan ___ win the match.
___ you help me carry this box, please?

title: present continuous for future arrangements
rule_uz: Present Continuous bilan kelajakda bo'ladigan va oldindan kelishilgan ishlar haqida ham gapirish mumkin. Shakli: am / is / are + fe'l-ing. Odatda ertaga, shu kecha, shanba kuni kabi vaqt so'zi bo'ladi. Masalan: I am meeting my cousin on Saturday. Bu yerda vaqt, joy yoki odam allaqachon kelishilgan.

examples.en: I am meeting my cousin on Saturday.
We are going to the cinema tonight.
What are you doing this evening?

mistakes.right: I am meeting my friend tomorrow.
mistakes.note_uz: Am / is / are tushib qolmasligi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: She visits her aunt tomorrow, it is arranged.
mistakes.right: She is visiting her aunt tomorrow.
mistakes.note_uz: Kelishilgan reja uchun is visiting ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: Next Friday I ___ my cousin.
We ___ to the cinema tonight. I have already bought the tickets.
She ___ her grandparents next weekend.
What ___ you doing this evening?
Tom ___ a match tomorrow at 4 o'clock.
I'm busy on Monday. I ___ to the dentist.

title: must / mustn't; have to / don't have to
rule_uz: Must va have to majburiyatni bildiradi: You must listen. She has to get up early. Mustn't "mumkin emas" degani, taqiqni bildiradi: You mustn't run here. Don't have to esa "shart emas" degani: We don't have to go to school on Sunday. O'tgan zamonda must o'rniga had to ishlatiladi: I had to wait.
forms: I / you / we / they have to + verb
He / she / it has to + verb

examples.en: You must listen to your teacher.
You mustn't run in the corridor.
We don't have to wear a uniform on Friday.
examples.uz: Juma kuni forma kiyishimiz shart emas.

mistakes.note_uz: Must dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.
He / she / it bilan has to ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You ___ listen to your teacher.
You ___ run in the corridor. It's dangerous.
Tomorrow is a holiday. We ___ go to school.
She ___ get up early on school days.
Do you ___ wear a uniform at your school?
Yesterday I ___ finish my homework before dinner.

title: should / shouldn't (advice)
rule_uz: Maslahat berganda should ishlatamiz: You should rest. Bu "yaxshi bo'lardi" degani. Qilmaslik kerak bo'lgan ish uchun shouldn't deymiz: You shouldn't eat so many sweets. Should hamma shaxslarda bir xil, -s qo'shilmaydi. Undan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi, to kerak emas. Savol: Should I ask the teacher?
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + should + verb

examples.en: You are tired. You should go to bed early.
You shouldn't eat so many sweets.
Should I ask my teacher for help?

mistakes.note_uz: Should dan keyin to kerak emas.
Should ga -s qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: You are tired. You ___ go to bed early.
You ___ eat so many sweets. They are bad for your teeth.
He has a headache. He ___ take a rest.
___ I ask my teacher for help?
Kids ___ play with fire.
My dog is ill. I think I ___ take it to the vet.

title: could / couldn't; was able to
rule_uz: Could o'tgan zamondagi umumiy qobiliyatni bildiradi: When I was five, I could swim. Inkori couldn't. Savol: Could you ride a bike? Aniq bir marta uddalagan ishda was / were able to ishlatamiz: Yesterday I was able to finish the test. Could dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi.
forms: I / you / he / she / we / they + could + verb

examples.en: When I was five, I could swim.
I was ill, so I couldn't come to school.
examples.uz: Kasal edim, shuning uchun maktabga kela olmadim.

examples.en: The boy fell in the river, but he was able to swim to the bank.
examples.uz: Bola daryoga yiqildi, lekin qirg'oqqa suzib chiqa oldi.

mistakes.wrong: I can swim when I was five.
mistakes.right: I could swim when I was five.
mistakes.note_uz: O'tgan zamon haqida gapirganda can emas, could ishlatiladi.
Didn't can / could deb bo'lmaydi, couldn't ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: When I was five, I ___ swim.
My grandfather ___ read when he was a child because he had no school.
___ you ride a bike when you were six?
I was ill yesterday, so I ___ come to school.
Yesterday the test was hard, but I ___ finish it.
The boy fell in the river, but he ___ swim to the bank.

title: may / might (possibility)
rule_uz: May va might biror narsa bo'lishi mumkinligini, lekin aniq emasligini bildiradi: It might rain later. Ali may be at home. Ikkalasidan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi, to va -s qo'shilmaydi. Inkori may not, might not. May ruxsat so'rashda ham ishlatiladi: May I go out, please?
forms: I / he / she / it / we / they + may + verb
I / he / she / it / we / they + might + verb

examples.en: It might rain later. Take an umbrella.
examples.uz: Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin. Soyabon oling.

examples.en: Ali may be at home.
May I go to the toilet, please?

mistakes.note_uz: Might ga -s qo'shilmaydi.
May dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It ___ rain later. Take an umbrella.
I'm not sure. Ali ___ be at home.
___ I go to the toilet, please?
We ___ go to the beach on Sunday, but we haven't decided.
She ___ come to the party. She isn't sure yet.
Mum ___ buy me a new phone for my birthday, but I'm not sure.

title: present perfect: ever / never (experiences)
rule_uz: Hayotingizda biror narsani qilganmisiz yoki yo'qmi, shu haqida gapirganda Present Perfect ishlatamiz. U have/has + fe'lning 3-shakli (past participle) bilan yasaladi: I have visited, she has seen. Savolda ever (hech qachon, biror marta) ishlatamiz: Have you ever ridden a horse? Inkorda never (hech qachon) ishlatamiz: I have never eaten sushi. He, she, it bilan has ishlatiladi.
forms: I / you / we / they + have + visited / seen
He / she / it + has + visited / seen
Have you ever + seen a whale?

examples.en: I have visited Samarkand three times.
Have you ever ridden a horse?
My brother has never seen snow.

mistakes.wrong: I have never see a camel.
mistakes.right: I have never seen a camel.
mistakes.note_uz: Have dan keyin fe'lning 3-shakli (seen) keladi.
She bilan has ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I have ___ a lion at the zoo.
Have you ever ___ pizza?
My sister ___ never flown in a plane.
They have never ___ to Japan.
___ you ever played chess?
Tom has ___ broken his arm, so he is very lucky.

title: present perfect: just / already / yet
rule_uz: Present Perfect yaqinda bo'lgan yoki hozirga aloqador ishlar uchun kerak. Just yaqinda, hozirgina degani: I have just finished. Already allaqachon degani va darak gaplarda ishlatiladi: She has already eaten. Yet hali degani, savol va inkor gaplarda gap oxirida keladi: Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.

examples.en: I have just finished my homework.
Mum has already made lunch.
Have you cleaned your room yet?

mistakes.note_uz: Darak gapda yet emas, already ishlatiladi; inkorda yet to'g'ri.
Already darak gaplarda ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I have ___ seen that film. It was great!
We have ___ eaten, so we are not hungry.
Have you done your homework ___?
He hasn't called me ___.
The bus ___ left. We are too late.
Has the film started ___? No, it starts in five minutes.

title: present perfect: for / since
rule_uz: Biror ish yoki holat o'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan bo'lsa, Present Perfect ishlatamiz: I have lived here for five years. For bilan vaqt davomini aytamiz: for two hours, for three days, for a year. Since bilan boshlanish paytini aytamiz: since Monday, since 2020, since 5 o'clock. How long...? deb so'raymiz: How long have you known him?
forms: have / has + past participle + for + davomiylik (for two years)
have / has + past participle + since + boshlanish payti (since 2020)
How long + have / has + subject + past participle?

examples.en: I have had this bike for two years.
examples.uz: Bu velosipedim ikki yildan beri menda.

examples.en: She has lived in Tashkent since 2019.
How long have you known Ali?

mistakes.wrong: I have known her since three years.
mistakes.right: I have known her for three years.
mistakes.note_uz: Davomiylik (three years) bilan for ishlatiladi.

mistakes.right: He has been sick since Monday.
mistakes.note_uz: Since bilan Present Perfect kerak, is emas.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: We have lived here ___ ten years.
She has been in the garden ___ lunch.
I have played the guitar ___ 2022.
Tom has had a cold ___ three days.
How long ___ you studied English?
My grandfather has worked at the school ___ a long time.

title: past continuous
rule_uz: O'tmishda ma'lum bir paytda davom etib turgan ish haqida gapirganda Past Continuous ishlatamiz. U was/were + fe'l-ing bilan yasaladi: I was reading, they were playing. I, he, she, it bilan was, you, we, they bilan were ishlatamiz. Inkorda wasn't/weren't, savolda Was/Were gap boshiga chiqadi: Were you sleeping?
forms: I / he / she / it + was + playing

examples.en: At eight o'clock I was eating breakfast.
examples.uz: Soat sakkizda men nonushta qilayotgan edim.

examples.en: The children were playing in the park.
Was it raining when you left?

mistakes.note_uz: She bilan was ishlatiladi.
They bilan were ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I ___ my homework when you called.
The birds ___ in the tree when I walked past.
My dad ___ cooking at seven last night.
___ you watching TV at nine o'clock?
We ___ playing football, so we didn't hear the phone.
It ___ raining, so we stayed at home.

title: past continuous vs past simple (when / while)
rule_uz: Uzoq davom etgan ishni Past Continuous bilan, uni to'xtatgan qisqa voqeani Past Simple bilan aytamiz. Masalan: I was walking (uzoq ish) when I saw a dog (qisqa voqea). While bilan odatda davom etgan ish keladi: While I was walking, I saw a dog. When bilan ko'pincha qisqa voqea keladi: When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
forms: was / were + -ing (uzoq ish) + when + past simple
When + past simple (qisqa voqea), + was / were + -ing

examples.en: I was cooking when my friend called.
examples.uz: Do'stim qo'ng'iroq qilganda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.

examples.en: While we were walking home, it started to rain.
examples.uz: Uyga piyoda ketayotganimizda yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

examples.en: When the teacher came in, we were talking.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi kirganda biz gaplashib turgan edik.

mistakes.wrong: While I walked, I fell down.
mistakes.right: While I was walking, I fell down.
mistakes.note_uz: While bilan davom etgan ish Past Continuous bo'ladi.

mistakes.wrong: I was seeing a bird when I walked.
mistakes.right: I saw a bird while I was walking.
mistakes.note_uz: Qisqa voqea Past Simple bilan aytiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I was sleeping when the phone ___.
While Dilya ___ her bike, she fell off.
We ___ TV when the lights went out.
When I arrived, my friends ___ football.
He broke his leg while he ___ skiing.
The students were writing when the teacher ___ in.

title: too / enough
rule_uz: Too 'ortiqcha, haddan tashqari' degani va salbiy ma'no beradi. U sifat oldidan keladi: too hot, too small. Enough 'yetarli' degani. Sifatdan keyin keladi: old enough, big enough. Otdan oldin keladi: enough water, enough time. Fe'l oldidan to ishlatish mumkin: too tired to play, old enough to ride.

examples.en: This bag is too heavy for me.
examples.uz: Bu sumka men uchun juda og'ir.

examples.en: I am not tall enough to reach the shelf.
examples.uz: Men tokchaga yetadigan darajada bo'yli emasman.

examples.en: We have enough juice for everyone.

mistakes.note_uz: Enough sifatdan keyin keladi.

mistakes.wrong: The soup is too much hot.
mistakes.note_uz: Too sifat oldida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The tea is ___ hot to drink. I will wait.
He is not old ___ to drive a car.
We don't have ___ chairs for everyone.
I can't carry this box. It is ___ heavy.
Is the room warm ___ for you?
She was ___ tired to finish her homework.

title: much / many / a lot of / a few / a little
title_uz: much / many / a lot of / a few / a little
rule_uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan (apples, books) many va a few ishlatamiz. Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan (water, time) much va a little ishlatamiz. A lot of ikkalasi bilan ham ishlatiladi. Much va many ko'pincha inkor gaplarda va savollarda keladi: How many books? There isn't much milk. A few va a little 'bir oz, ozgina' degani.
forms: many / a few + sanaladigan ot (many apples)
much / a little + sanalmaydigan ot (much water)

examples.en: There are a few apples on the table.
I don't have much time today.
We have a lot of homework.

mistakes.wrong: How much books do you have?
mistakes.right: How many books do you have?
mistakes.note_uz: Books sanaladigan ot, shuning uchun many.
Water sanalmaydi, shuning uchun a little.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: How ___ students are in your class?
There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
I have a ___ stickers in my bag.
Would you like some sugar? Just ___, please.
We didn't see ___ people at the park.
How ___ money do you need for the bus?

title: adverbs of manner (-ly, well, fast, hard)
rule_uz: Ravish ishning qanday bajarilishini bildiradi. Ko'p ravishlar sifatga -ly qo'shib yasaladi: slow - slowly, careful - carefully. Y bilan tugasa: easy - easily. Ba'zi so'zlar o'zgarmaydi: fast - fast, hard - hard. Good sifatining ravishi well: She sings well. Ravish odatda fe'ldan yoki to'ldiruvchidan keyin turadi.
forms: sifat + ly: quick - quickly, careful - carefully

examples.en: The turtle walks slowly.
My brother runs very fast.
She speaks English well.

mistakes.note_uz: Fe'lni bildiruvchi so'z ravish bo'ladi: well.
Fast o'zgarmaydi, -ly qo'shilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: The baby is sleeping ___.
Please open the box ___. It is made of glass.
My cousin swims very ___.
The car goes ___ on the highway.
Maria studies ___ for every exam.
He won the race ___.

title: infinitive of purpose; verb + to / verb + -ing
rule_uz: Biror ishni nima uchun qilishimizni aytganda to + fe'l ishlatamiz: I go to school to learn. Savol: Why? Javob: To ... Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin to + fe'l keladi: want, need, hope, decide, learn. Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing keladi: enjoy, like, finish, stop. Masalan: I want to swim, I enjoy swimming.
forms: Subject + fe'l + to + fe'l (maqsad): I use a map to find the way.
want / need / decide / hope + to + fe'l

examples.en: She goes to the library to borrow books.
examples.uz: U kitob olish uchun kutubxonaga boradi.

examples.en: I want to be a doctor.
We enjoy playing chess.

mistakes.note_uz: Enjoy dan keyin -ing keladi.

mistakes.wrong: I went to shop for to buy bread.
mistakes.right: I went to the shop to buy bread.
mistakes.note_uz: Maqsadni aytishda for emas, to + fe'l ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I went to the shop ___ some milk.
She wants ___ a new bike.
My dad enjoys ___ in the garden.
We finished ___ our room at five.
They decided ___ to the zoo on Sunday.
He called me ___ about the party.

title: first conditional (if + present, will)
rule_uz: Kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan holat va uning natijasi haqida gapirganda First Conditional ishlatamiz. If bilan boshlangan qismda oddiy hozirgi zamon (Present Simple) keladi, natija qismida will + fe'l keladi: If it rains, we will stay at home. If qismida will ishlatilmaydi. Gap if bilan boshlansa, vergul qo'yiladi.
forms: If you study, you will pass.
Will + subject + fe'l + if + Present Simple?

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If you eat too much candy, you will feel sick.
examples.uz: Juda ko'p shirinlik yesang, ko'ngling aynib qoladi.

examples.en: I will help you if you ask me.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, we will stay home.
mistakes.note_uz: If qismida will ishlatilmaydi, Present Simple ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: If I will see him, I will tell him.
mistakes.right: If I see him, I will tell him.
mistakes.note_uz: If dan keyin will emas, oddiy hozirgi zamon.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: If I finish early, I ___ you.
If it ___ tomorrow, we will go to the beach.
If you don't hurry, you ___ the bus.
She will be happy if she ___ the prize.
If we ___ now, we won't be late.
What ___ you do if it snows on Saturday?

title: zero conditional and when-clauses
title_uz: Nolinchi shart gap (Zero Conditional) va when
rule_uz: Doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan narsalar va tabiat qonunlari haqida gapirganda Zero Conditional ishlatamiz. Ikkala qismda ham oddiy hozirgi zamon (Present Simple) keladi: If you heat ice, it melts. Bu yerda if o'rniga when ham ishlatsa bo'ladi: When it rains, the grass gets wet. Will ishlatilmaydi, chunki bu har doim bo'ladigan narsa.
forms: If / When + Present Simple, + Present Simple
If you heat ice, it melts.
When I am tired, I go to bed early.
Present Simple + if / when + Present Simple

examples.en: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
examples.uz: Ko'k bilan sariqni aralashtirsang, yashil chiqadi.

examples.en: When it is cold, water turns to ice.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lsa, suv muzga aylanadi.

examples.en: I feel happy when I play with my dog.
examples.uz: Itim bilan o'ynasam, o'zimni xursand his qilaman.

mistakes.wrong: If you heat ice, it will melt always.
mistakes.right: If you heat ice, it melts.
mistakes.note_uz: Doim to'g'ri narsada Present Simple ishlatiladi, will kerak emas.

mistakes.wrong: When it will rain, the grass is wet.
mistakes.right: When it rains, the grass gets wet.
mistakes.note_uz: When dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ___.
When the sun goes down, it ___ dark.
If you press this button, the light ___ on.
Plants ___ if you don't give them water.
When my sister ___ a cold, she stays in bed.
If you freeze water, it ___ into ice.

title: possessive pronouns (mine, yours) and whose
rule_uz: Possessive pronoun (egalik olmoshi) otning o'rniga keladi va ot bilan birga ishlatilmaydi: mine (meniki), yours (seniki), his (uniki), hers (uniki), ours (bizniki), theirs (ularniki). Masalan: This is my book = This book is mine. Whose bilan kimniki ekanini so'raymiz: Whose bag is this? Javob: It's mine.
forms: my - mine, your - yours, his - his
her - hers, our - ours, their - theirs
Subject + is / are + mine / yours / hers...

examples.en: This pencil is mine, not yours.
Whose bag is this? It's hers.
Our house is big, but theirs is bigger.
examples.uz: Bizning uyimiz katta, lekin ularniki kattaroq.

mistakes.note_uz: Mine ot bilan birga kelmaydi; ot bilan my ishlatiladi.
Kimniki deb so'rash uchun whose ishlatiladi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: This is not your pen. It is ___.
___ coat is this? It is Sara's.
Those books are ___. We bought them yesterday.
I like your bike, but ___ is faster.
The red car isn't ours. It's ___.
Is this your cap? No, it isn't ___. It's his.

title: reflexive pronouns (myself, himself)
rule_uz: Ish bajaruvchi va ishni qabul qiluvchi bir xil odam bo'lsa, qaytuv olmoshi ishlatamiz: I cut myself. Shakllari: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves. Singular -self, plural -selves bilan tugaydi. By myself degani 'yolg'iz o'zim, hech kimsiz' deganidir: I did it by myself.
forms: he - himself, she - herself, it - itself
we - ourselves, you - yourselves, they - themselves

examples.en: I hurt myself while I was playing.
She made this cake herself.
The kids cleaned the room by themselves.

mistakes.wrong: He looked at him in the mirror.
mistakes.right: He looked at himself in the mirror.
mistakes.note_uz: Ish egasi bilan bir kishi bo'lsa himself ishlatiladi.
To'g'ri shakl themselves.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I cut ___ with a knife. Ouch!
Anna looked at ___ in the mirror.
We built the tree house by ___.
The boys enjoyed ___ at the party.
The cat washed ___ in the sun.
Be careful, Ali! Don't hurt ___.

title: linking words: and, but, so, because, although
title_uz: Bog'lovchilar: and, but, so, because, although
rule_uz: Bog'lovchi so'zlar gaplarni bir-biriga bog'laydi. And - va, qo'shish uchun. But - lekin, qarama-qarshilik uchun. So - shuning uchun, natijani aytadi: It was cold, so I wore a coat. Because - chunki, sababni aytadi: I wore a coat because it was cold. Although - garchi, ...ga qaramay: Although it was cold, I went out. But va although bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.
examples.uz: Qornim och edi, shuning uchun sendvich yasadim.

examples.en: He stayed at home because he was ill.
examples.uz: U kasal bo'lgani uchun uyda qoldi.

examples.en: Although it was late, we kept playing.
examples.uz: Kech bo'lishiga qaramay, biz o'ynashda davom etdik.

mistakes.wrong: I was tired so I went to bed because.
mistakes.right: I was tired, so I went to bed.
mistakes.note_uz: So natijani aytadi; because sababdan oldin turadi.

mistakes.wrong: Although it rained, but we played.
mistakes.note_uz: Although bilan but birga ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: I like tea ___ I don't like coffee.
We were thirsty, ___ we bought some water.
She is happy ___ she won the game.
Tom likes pizza ___ pasta.
___ it was raining, they played outside.
He was very tired, ___ he finished his homework.

title: question tags (basic)
rule_uz: Question tag - gap oxiridagi qisqa savol. U biror narsani tasdiqlatish yoki tekshirish uchun ishlatiladi. Darak gapdan keyin inkor tag keladi: You are a student, aren't you? Inkor gapdan keyin darak tag keladi: She isn't here, is she? Tag da gapdagi yordamchi fe'l va olmosh ishlatiladi. Present Simple da do/does/don't/doesn't, past simple da did/didn't ishlatiladi.
forms: Darak gap + inkor tag: It is cold, isn't it?
Inkor gap + darak tag: You can't swim, can you?
Present Simple: You like pizza, don't you?
Past Simple: He came, didn't he?

examples.en: You are Ali's brother, aren't you?
She doesn't like fish, does she?
They played football yesterday, didn't they?

mistakes.note_uz: Likes bilan doesn't ishlatiladi, is/isn't emas.
Darak gapdan keyin inkor tag kerak.

exercises.sentence_with_blank: It is a nice day, ___?
You don't like spiders, ___?
Your sister plays the violin, ___?
They aren't at school today, ___?
Tom came late yesterday, ___?
We can sit here, ___?
